dedupe_keys.name: neighbor influenced energy retrofit nier agent based model

description: NIER adds the type of building owner and the scale of the peer group to models of energy efficiency retrofit adoption in commercial and multi-owner buildings. It came out of qualitative research with interviews of key stakeholders in Cleveland, Ohio and in Detroit and Grand Rapids, Michigan, and contrasts owner strategies for managing buildings with comparisons across neighbourhoods of different sizes and large districts. Among its insights, large peer group comparisons can speed retrofits in a district beyond what economic feasibility alone predicts. It was published by Eric Boria of the University of Illinois Chicago in April 2020 and is peer reviewed on CoMSES. Coverage: stylised US Midwest cities. Access: free NetLogo code on CoMSES with a DOI. Licence: GPL-3.0. Caveats: an exploratory model calibrated on interviews, not on retrofit records. Simulation uses are testing how district programmes and benchmarking peer groups change retrofit uptake in building stock scenarios. Related records: the HERB household retrofit model and the CEDSS community energy demand model.
inputs: Building owner types and their management strategies
name: Neighbor Influenced Energy Retrofit (NIER) agent-based model
outputs: Retrofit adoption over time by owner type and peer group
